$comment: C5.7a (DELIVERY_REVIEW.md C11). Written by workflow/run_phase1_research.py (two sites, both `save_yaml(ARTIFACTS / 'grid_evaluation.yaml', ...)`: the N-column variant-loop grid and the flag-off single-column grid) from tools/verdict_criteria_evaluator.py::evaluate_grid plus the caller's `evaluated_at`. save_yaml checks it against this file by stem (tools/workflow_artifact_validation.py) -- warn-only by default, blocking only under WORKFLOW_ARTIFACT_VALIDATION=raise. Only orchestrator.grid_evaluation.enabled writes it. Code-written end to end, so the top level, the cells and the bar rows are closed (additionalProperties: false); the key sets are exactly what evaluate_grid / _evaluate_grid_cell_for_symbol / _evaluate_residual_ic_cell / _evaluate_profit_bars_cell / _grade_profit_bars(_v2) emit. Permissive on purpose, each because the code genuinely varies: (1) which keys a cell carries depends on its path (window/pooled, sign_consistent_by_era, residual_ic, profit_bars, per_symbol_all roll-up, floor/None INCONCLUSIVE, SPEC_ERROR), so every cell key except `result` is optional; (2) `value`/`threshold`/`actual` are number-or-null (a fully_explained residual_ic FAIL and an unevaluable bar carry null; sign_consistent_by_era cells carry neither); (3) the residual_ic pass-through fields (n_eff, p_value_one_sided, composite, fully_explained, max_p_value) are copied from an externally computed mapping and are left untyped; (4) `weight_schedule` is copied from the composition manifest and left untyped; (5) a bar row's `detail` is a free mapping. Cross-field rules that JSON Schema can state are stated (SPEC_ERROR <-> idea_status null; refused:/backtest_failed: prefixes); the rules that need the whole grid (idea_status rolled up from the cells, grid keys equal to criteria x variants, no variant both graded and failed/untested) are asserted in tests/test_c5_7a_schemas.py, not here.
title: runs/<run>/artifacts/grid_evaluation.yaml
description: The grid: criteria x graded variants, every cell mechanical, plus the idea-level status rolled up from the cells (any genuine FAIL refutes; else any INCONCLUSIVE cell, or any variant without a graded result, is inconclusive; else validated).

variants.description: GRADED columns only (variant ids; the run id for the flag-off single-column grid). A failed / untested variant is never a column.

failed_variants.description: E-061 C2 S2a (D-015). Present only when non-empty. {variant_id: reason}; `refused:` = refused before any backtest (no trial row), `backtest_failed:` = a spent look.

untested_variants.description: E-061 C2 S2a (card D). Present only when non-empty. {variant_id: reason} for variants of the idea with no graded column in this run.

partial_coverage_variants.description: E-061 C2 S2b (D-042, temporary). Present only when non-empty. {variant_id: reason} for GRADED columns that ran on fewer windows than the run protocol.

per_symbol.description: symbol_reducer=per_symbol_all roll-up only: {symbol: cell}; the cell's result is the dominant one (SPEC_ERROR > FAIL > INCONCLUSIVE > PASS).
